title: Atelier provides £7.3m loan for Lewisham apartment scheme
summary:
Development finance lender Atelier has provided a £7.3 million loan to fund the acquisition and construction of 17 apartments on a brownfield site in Lewisham, south-east London. The transaction was structured at 67% loan-to-gross development value over a 24-month term.

title: Energy-generating homes see rising buyer interest
summary:
Buyer demand for properties capable of generating their own energy has increased significantly, according to Rightmove data, with 63% of movers preferring homes that produce most or all of their own power. The shift follows volatile energy prices and summer heatwaves, though energy-efficient features remain concentrated in higher-priced properties.

title: Inflation rise prompts expectation of two rate hikes
summary:
Financial markets are anticipating two interest rate increases before the end of the year following inflation rising from 3.1% to 3.5% between August and September. The consumer prices index jump, driven primarily by petrol prices, could push mortgage rates higher and impact property market affordability.

title: Buy-to-let lending rises 20% but growth context questioned
summary:
Buy-to-let mortgage lending increased by 20.6% in the second quarter of 2026, according to UK Finance, though the comparison reflects an unusually weak baseline from 2025. Remortgaging activity drove volumes as landlords refinanced expiring fixed-rate deals, while arrears fell 25.6% year-on-year.

summary:

title: Boydens expands block management into London
summary:
Colchester-based estate and lettings agent Boydens has secured its first block management clients in London, marking a geographical expansion for the firm's property management division. The company now manages more than 3,000 units across Essex and Suffolk from its Colchester head office.

title: UK house price growth slows for fourth consecutive month
summary:
Annual house price growth in the UK decelerated for the fourth consecutive month in August, according to the latest Land Registry data, with the average property price reaching £272,611. The Land Registry House Price Index showed annual price growth of 0.9% in August, down from 1.2% in July.

title: Prime London property listings decline 3.4% in Q3
summary:
The number of properties available for sale in London's prime market fell by 3.4% during the three months to September 2025, according to data from Benham and Reeves. The decline occurred during a period when Chancellor John Healey was reportedly considering lowering the threshold for the Mansion Tax from £2 million to £1.5 million.

title: Most homebuyers search for property outside office hours
summary:
Three-quarters of homebuyers conduct property searches after 5pm when most estate agency offices are closed, according to research by Street.co.uk. A survey of 1,073 recent buyers found 40% browse between 5pm and 8pm, whilst 35% search after 8pm.

title: Quantum provides £30m for 232-bed Durham student scheme
summary:
Quantum Development Finance has provided £30 million in debt funding to Asset Capital for the development of Melbury Court, a 232-bed purpose-built student accommodation scheme in Durham. The project carries a gross development value of £46 million and is scheduled for completion in summer 2027.
